responsibility: Bounded one-request stdio adapter for the shared device-preference authority, consumed by Desktop through an exact verified artifact. The local-site-runtime library owns scope resolution, native initial-source admission, source comparison and atomic storage; the workbench-protocol library owns the closed values and request contract.
nonGoals: Owning settings UI, application configuration publication, terminal provisioning or notification delivery.
Accepting request-selected paths, starting a Site, remote transport, arbitrary commands, or daemon lifetime.
